newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 3c to 624c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 3c to 624c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator retreated three cents to 624 cents a kg clean on Thursday at sales in Newcastle and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was mostly cheaper, with 19/21/24 microns 0.5 percent cheaper, 20m 1.5 percent cheaper, 22/23/25m slightly cheaper and 26m unchanged.
Merino skirtings of 19m were slightly dearer, with 20/21/22m generally unchanged.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were slightly cheaper and 29/30/31 unchanged, it said.
